title: A tube of this lash serum is sold every 30 seconds
summary: Who would’ve thought that a husband’s gift to his wife during her breast cancer battle would become one of beauty’s most recognisable lash innovations?

extraction.key_fact: 한 부부의 사연에서 시작된 속눈썹 세럼이 가장 널리 알려진 속눈썹 제품이 됐다.
